# stb_image

`stb_image.h` is vendored from https://github.com/nothings/stb at commit
`2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20` (upstream v2.30). The header includes
its complete public-domain / MIT dual license. Coach compiles only the JPEG and
PNG decoders, with file access disabled and a 4096-pixel dimension bound.
